# Anass Ez-zouaine — Senior Backend Engineer · Software Architect · AI Engineer

> Personal site, portfolio, and engineering blog of Anass Ez-zouaine. Shipping
> production Laravel SaaS, Shopify Plus apps, and AI features (Anthropic
> Claude, MCP, RAG, agentic systems) since 2012. Remote-first since 2014, based
> in Meknes, Morocco. Open to senior / lead / fractional CTO and advisory
> engagements, contract or employed.
